items.title: The Real Price of Marvell Stock's Growth
items.summary: If you hold Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock, you’ve seen its price fluctuate. The company is posting strong growth, raising its revenue outlook for next year by $1.5 billion in a single quarter. Yet the stock is well off its highs, and it recently dropped even after reporting those results. This isn't a contradiction; it’s a signal that the market is focused on a new, more complicated question. The central risk for Marvell isn't that its AI-driven growth will stop. items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock is back in focus after the company and partners Cisco and HUMAIN outlined plans to deploy up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure in Saudi Arabia starting in 2027. Despite the Saudi AI announcement and other partnerships around secure AI infrastructure, Advanced Micro Devices’ recent share price has eased, with the 7-day share price return down 4.08% and the 90-day share price return down 15.28%.
